behaviors_asserted: getContent should return file metadata (for example modified timestamp and file size) along with the file data.
Serve static middleware should send a Last-Modified header with the static file contents.
Serve static middleware should inspect the request's If-Modified-Since header and return a 304 Not Modified when the file has not changed.
Serve static middleware should ensure Content-Length is available so the Content-Length header can be sent for static files.
